In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥497 million and there was a segment loss of ¥422 million, compared with a segment profit of ¥502 million in the previous fiscal year (the fiscal year ended March 2025). The securities report cites the fact that no new investment partnership was formed and that the share prices of listed companies invested in fell, among other things, as the reasons for the results. Note that the securities report lists four business areas for the group as a whole: the self-investment business, the fund business, the PIPEs business, and the investment banking business; of these, it states that three—fund, PIPEs, and investment banking—are included in this segment.

entries.ffb4e5f4ed8efa44: The [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]] states that the group has a holding company structure, with the company formulating management strategies and providing management guidance to group companies, and each subsidiary conducting business activities. It has 3 [[term:segment|reporting segments]] by type of business: the Financial Solutions Business, the DX Solutions Business, and the Marketing Solutions Business. The group consists of the company, 21 consolidated subsidiaries, and 41 equity-method affiliates. The annual securities report states that it aims to be a group that supports Japan's growth by providing financial solutions that fuse the power of AI and finance to accelerate business growth, in 4 areas: the proprietary investment business, the fund business, the PIPEs business, and the investment banking business. Of revenue of ¥3,297 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥1,302 million for the Marketing Solutions Business, ¥1,290 million for the DX Solutions Business, and ¥497 million for the Financial Solutions Business. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, operating loss was ¥1,387 million, while in the previous fiscal year operating profit was ¥1,427 million.
